name: Hims Mental Health
one_liner: Online provider evaluation and monthly medication plans for anxiety and depression, aimed at men, paid out of pocket from $49/month.
best_for: Adults with anxiety or depression who want an online evaluation and non-controlled medication such as an SSRI
People comfortable paying cash for a monthly medication plan
People who want to message a provider about dose changes
not_for: Anyone in crisis: call or text 988
People who want talk therapy (Hims lists medication care only)
People who want to use insurance, Medicare or Medicaid
People who need controlled medications such as Xanax or Adderall, or care for severe or complex conditions
short_description: Hims sells online anxiety and depression care: an evaluation by a licensed provider, then a monthly medication plan from $49 with follow-ups and messaging.
long_description: Hims (Hims & Hers Health) offers online mental health care aimed at men. You complete an online assessment, an independent licensed provider decides whether medication is appropriate, and if prescribed you get a monthly plan that includes the medication, follow-ups, dose adjustments and unlimited messaging with providers. Medications listed include sertraline, escitalopram, citalopram, fluoxetine, paroxetine, duloxetine, venlafaxine, bupropion and buspirone; controlled drugs such as Xanax and Adderall are not offered. Plans start at $49 a month and Hims does not accept insurance, Medicare or Medicaid. Hims's privacy policy says it may sell sensitive personal data and shares some data with advertising partners. There are no published studies of Hims's mental health service.

pricing.notes: Price depends on the medication and plan. Includes provider evaluation, follow-ups, dose adjustments and messaging. No insurance, Medicare or Medicaid accepted.

privacy.notes: Policy states "we may sell your sensitive personal data" and shares identifiers and activity with ad partners; Hims itself is not a HIPAA covered entity, but its medical groups have a notice of privacy practices.

faqs.q: How much does Hims mental health cost?
faqs.a: Hims doesn't accept insurance—it's cash-pay only. Medication consultations start around $25. Generic antidepressants and anti-anxiety medications cost approximately $20-30/month. Therapy sessions are additional. Pricing is transparent on their website.

faqs.q: What mental health medications does Hims prescribe?
faqs.a: Hims prescribes common anxiety and depression medications including SSRIs (like generic Lexapro, Zoloft) and other non-controlled medications. They don't prescribe controlled substances like benzodiazepines or stimulants. A licensed provider evaluates your needs.

No, Hims operates on a cash-pay model without insurance. Pricing is straightforward and often competitive with insurance copays, but you can't use your health insurance benefits. HSA/FSA cards may be accepted.

faqs.q: Is Hims legitimate for mental health?
faqs.a: Yes, Hims uses licensed physicians and nurse practitioners. It's convenient for mild to moderate anxiety and depression when you want simple medication access. For complex conditions or those needing therapy, other platforms may be more appropriate.

primary_uses: Online evaluation for anxiety or depression

patient_summary: You fill in an online assessment and a licensed provider reviews it; if medication suits you, it's shipped with ongoing follow-ups and messaging. Plans start at $49 a month, paid out of pocket, with no insurance. Hims offers medication only, not therapy or controlled drugs.

availability.note: US only; Hims says asynchronous visits are not available in all states.
